M-AUDIT-CLI.Summary: Dependency-free Node CLI of smart-audit: opens a run pinned to a commit, checks single documents, computes scores, lints a run, compares it with the previous run, and renders Markdown and HTML reports.

M-AUDIT-SKILL.Summary: The smart-audit skill: orchestrator instructions, recon, auditor, and verifier agent prompts, reference documents for the findings contract, scoring, untrusted input, and run layout, and the JSON Schemas of run artifacts.

M-AUDIT-RUBRICS.Summary: Rubrics of the five audits: prose method and evidence rules per audit, machine-readable criteria lists with versions, and run profiles.

M-AUDIT-PLUGIN.Summary: Thin Claude Code plugin wrapper: plugin and marketplace manifests and the audit command that delegates to the smart-audit skill.
